name: uc41_display
notes: Universal Controller 4.1 (Tip Charger) display - do NOT flash onto a Plasma StandAlone panel. 4.1.39C TEST BUILD: AUTO ON + AUTO OFF, no hiccups. Tips in fires plasma and it runs steady. Tips out: when a reading goes above what tips-in gives (>90) the plasma is switched off for a moment and the sensor read while quiet; tips out stops the plasma (~1-2 s after pulling, as 4.1.39B on the bench). 4.1.39B's routine 5 s check (the hiccup with tips held) is removed. HARD CAP: plasma never stays on past the slider time + 0.5 s (blinking 888 if the cap had to act). On-screen label still reads 4.1.38. Program only (.4XE), uSD untouched.
